assertion: US traffic deaths fell in the first half of this year to the lowest rate since 2014
independent_value: NHTSA early estimate rate 1.02 per 100M VMT vs 1.05 a year earlier, per secondary reports; NHTSA press release 403. Projection, not final.
searched: NHTSA early estimate first half 2026 traffic fatalities 16,750 Reuters Shepardson

assertion: traffic deaths dropped 2.5% to 16,750 in the first half of the year. It was the lowest number since 2015 and down from 17,175 in the same period last year.
independent_value: 16,750/17,175 = -2.47%; consistent arithmetic; early estimate; 'lowest since 2015' not verifiable with half-year data

assertion: This year is on pace to be the fifth straight year of declines
warehouse_value: FARS 2021 43,230; 2022 42,721; 2023 41,025; 2024 39,254 (three straight declines); NHTSA 2025 early est. 36,640 (fourth); 2026 H1 -2.5% (projection, Q2 only -0.2%)
sql: SELECT year, SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes_by_state_year WHERE year>=2014 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

assertion: US traffic deaths jumped 10.8% in 2021 to 43,230, the most in a single year since 2005.
sql: SELECT year, SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes_by_state_year GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
independent_value: FARS series 2008-2024 shows 2021 as peak; 2005 not loaded

assertion: Full-year traffic deaths for 2025 fell to the lowest number since 2019 and the fatality rate fell to 1.10 fatalities per 100 million vehicle miles traveled, the second-lowest yearly figure in US history, NHTSA said.
independent_value: NHTSA DOT HS 813 829: 2025 est. 36,640 (above 2019's 36,355, below all later years) and rate 1.10. Early estimate. 'Second-lowest in history' not tested.

assertion: Deaths fell 5% in the first three months of 2026 but just 0.2% in the second three months.
independent_value: NHTSA Q1 2026 early estimate was -4.3% (7,770 deaths) per CollisionWeek; about 5% after later revision is plausible. Q2 -0.2% not verified at primary source.

assertion: One area of concern remains bicyclist deaths, which rose 4% to 1,148 last year. In 2023, bicyclist deaths hit their highest figure in more than four decades.
independent_value: NHTSA DOT HS 813 829 Table 2: pedalcyclists 1,103 (2024) to 1,148 (2025), +4%. 2023 'four decades' part not checked.
why_not: The Reuters passage matches the primary NHTSA table; warehouse has no bicyclist column (search_catalog 'bicyclist traffic deaths 2025' returned unmatched term).
